name: Foulspawn Skintaker

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: damage, and the target cannot spend healing surges (save ends)

powers.name: Steal Skin
powers.usageDetails: when the foulspawn skintaker has no one under the effect of this power

hit.description: damage. The foulspawn skintaker assumes the appearance of the target until the end of the encounter. Whenever the target uses a healing surge, the foulspawn skintaker regains half the hit points and the target regains the other half

powers.name: Identity Crisis
powers.trigger: when subject to a melee or ranged attack while adjacent to a target on which the foulspawn skintaker has used steal skin

effect.description: The target of steal skin becomes the attack’s target instead of the foulspawn skintaker.

powers.name: Twin Sympathy
powers.trigger: usable when attacked while within 5 squares of the target whose appearance it has assumed using steal skin

effect.description: The target of steal skin takes half the attack’s damage and the foulspawn skintaker takes the other half.
